title: Contention for the judgment-seat
summary: After Pahoran's death, his sons Pahoran, Paanchi, and Pacumeni contend for the judgment-seat, causing three divisions among the Nephites.

explicit_facts.text: Serious difficulty began among the Nephites at the commencement of the fortieth year of the judges.
Pahoran had died, and contention arose among his sons over who should have the judgment-seat.
Pahoran, Paanchi, and Pacumeni contended for the judgment-seat and caused the people to contend.
Pahoran had other sons, but these three contenders caused three divisions among the people.

narration.text: Pahoran had died, and gone the way of all the earth; therefore there began to be a serious contention concerning who should have the judgment-seat among the brethren, who were the sons of Pahoran.
Pahoran, Paanchi, and Pacumeni.
therefore, they did cause three divisions among the people.

title: Lamanite army gathers
summary: In the forty and first year of the reign of the judges, the Lamanites gather and arm an innumerable army. They then come down to pitch battle against the Nephites, led by Coriantumr.

explicit_facts.text: In the forty and first year of the reign of the judges, the Lamanites gathered an innumerable army of men and armed them with swords, cimeters, bows, arrows, head-plates, breastplates, and shields of every kind.

Coriantumr led them. He was a descendant of Zarahemla, a dissenter from among the Nephites, and a large and mighty man.
